senses.gloss:
m. (-मः)
A sort of drum.
E.
दु bad, ill, दम to subdue, affix अच्, नुम् augment.

m. (-न्दुः)
1 A name of VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA.
3 A kind of drum.
E.
दु difficult, दस to tame, affix डु, and नुम् inserted.

m. (-भिः)
1 A sort of large kettle drum.
2 A name of VARUṆA, regent of the ocean. The name of a Daitya or demon.
3 A pair or couple.
f. (-भिः-भी)
1 A die or dice.
2 Twice three spots on a dice, or a pair of dice, with three spots on each.
E.
दुन्दु imitative sound, and भा to utter, affix कि, or द्यौ heaven, उभ to fill, and deriv. irr.

m. (-रः)
1 A sort of red worm.
2 The smoke of a house.
3 A cat: other authorities have धुन्धुमार, q. v.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्)
Afflicting, injuring.
E.
दु to injure, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Suffering pain or fatigue.
2 Going, moving.
3 Shaken, agitated.
E.
दू to suffer, affix क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Being agitated or distressed.
2 Gone, having gone.
E.
दू to be agitated, क्तवतु aff.
